# CRATER CODE
> Elite technology studio crafting next-generation digital experiences. We build what others imagine.

CRATER CODE is a premier software engineering and design studio specializing in scalable full-stack web applications, mobile app development (Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin), interactive 3D WebGL experiences, cloud architecture & DevOps, custom AI/ML solutions, and blockchain technology. We also run Crater Code Academy, providing high-impact developer training in modern web, mobile, data science, and AI development.
